messages:
Mia (Support): FYI customer NimblyHealth was charged twice on auto-renew despite having a PO pending. Invoice IDs: INV-2026-00412 and INV-2026-00413. Both posted within ~30s.

Ashok (Billing): Can you paste the webhook events and the payment provider IDs?

Mia (Support): copying webhook payloads:
```json
{ "event": "payment.created", "payment_id": "pay_abc123", "invoice_id": "INV-2026-00412", "idempotency_key": null }
{ "event": "payment.created", "payment_id": "pay_def456", "invoice_id": "INV-2026-00413", "idempotency_key": null }
```

Sara (Payments): looks like idempotency missing. Is our retry worker reprocessing same invoice? @Jorge can you check background-job logs?

Jorge (Eng): pulled job logs — we retried a failed collect job twice due to transient auth failure to payment gateway. worker restarted and queued same invoice without idempotency key. snippet:
```bash
2026-03-17T10:12:05Z job=collect_invoice id=INV-2026-00412 attempt=1
2026-03-17T10:12:29Z job=collect_invoice id=INV-2026-00412 attempt=2
```

BillingBot: auto-refund-initiated -> REF-7890 for pay_def456 :money_with_wings:

Ashok (Billing): Let's issue full reversal for duplicate charge (pay_def456) and create credit note for the PO mismatch. Mia, please notify customer and confirm bank settlement window (~5–7 business days).

Mia (Support): Reached out to client, they asked for refund + written confirmation. I'll send the reversal notice.

Sara (Payments): Quick mitigation: enable dedupe by invoice_id in the retryer and surface missing idempotency as error. I'll open a PR and patch the worker to persist idempotency key before requeue.

Jorge (Eng): PR created: github.com/redwood/ops/pull/321 — adds dedupe layer and logs duplicate attempts. Rolling a hotfix to staging now.

Mia (Support): Customer confirmed refund email received. Closing ticket after funds show. cc @Ashok @Sara

Ashok (Billing): Marking customer account with note 'auto-renew race - refunded 2026-03-17 REF-7890'.

Mia (Support): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
